item.title: Man dead, woman injured in attempted murder-suicide in Germantown

item.title: Camden County resident diagnosed with active tuberculosis; health officials investigating
item.description: A Camden County resident has been diagnosed with active tuberculosis. Health officials are investigating possible exposures and testing close contacts.
